title: Normalizing Flow Maps
abstract: arXiv:2610.22711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scalable approaches to learning neural dynamical systems have placed diffusion, flow matching, and few-step generators in flow maps at the forefront of generative modeling. Such state-of-the-art models have limited access to explicit model densities despite evolving from classical generative modeling approaches that leveraged tractable likelihoods, e.g., Normalizing Flows and Autoregressive models. In this paper, we combine these threads of few-step generation and tractable sample likelihoods and introduce Normalizing Flow Maps (NFM), a class of exactly invertible pushforward maps that generalizes normalizing flows and flow maps. More precisely, NFMs learn the integrator of an underlying dynamical system, but crucially, they provide efficient exact likelihood evaluation by construction. translated_abstract: 可扩展的神经动力系统学习方法已将扩散模型、流匹配以及基于流映射的少步生成器推向了生成式建模的前沿。尽管这些最先进的模型源自利用易处理似然的经典生成式建模方法（例如标准化流和自回归模型），但它们在获取显式模型密度方面能力有限。在本文中，我们将少步生成与可处理的样本似然这两条技术路线相结合，提出了标准化流映射，这是一类精确可逆的推前映射，同时推广了标准化流和流映射。更准确地说，NFM 学习底层动力系统的积分器，但关键在于，它们在构造上即可提供高效的精确似然评估。为实现 NFM 的可扩展训练，我们推导了 NFM 固有的两个互补的一致性维度，它们可产生（自）蒸馏目标：（1）……
tldr: 本文提出标准化流映射（NFM），将流映射的少步生成能力与标准化流的精确似然评估相结合，通过学习底层动力系统的积分器，在构造上同时实现高效少步采样和精确密度估计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Normalizing Flow Maps (NFM), which unifies few-step generation from flow maps with tractable exact likelihoods from normalizing flows by learning the integrator of an underlying dynamical system, enabling by construction both efficient few-step sampling and exact density evaluation.
